events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of humour has kept us laughing for decades. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' 58th Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released in the UK on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A truly diverse collection that showed the Fab Four at their most experimental. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 years old.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years after his passing. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. He would have been 80 today. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' 61st Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', in the UK on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Folk-Rock Evolution
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound towards folk-rock and introspection. A true classic. Which track still resonates with you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 years old.

angles.name: Peace & Music Legacy
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. He would have been 86 today. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented music and style. Which era of Bowie do you love most?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: King of Rock
angles.copy: On his 92nd birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King's music still shakes, rattles, and rolls us! What's your favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs with Led Zeppelin changed rock music forever. What's your favourite Page solo?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The iconic British singer Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Timeless Rocker
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! From Faces to his incredible solo career, he's a true rock 'n' roll legend. What's your favourite Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Icon
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the voice of Madness! His energy and iconic tracks have been soundtracking our lives for decades. What's your favourite Madness hit?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful Pop Star
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! His 80s hits are still absolute classics. What's your go-to Paul Young track?

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary country music icon Dolly Parton, who would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: The one and only Dolly Parton would have been 81 today. Her incredible songs and spirit continue to shine brightly. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Leader
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! A fantastic songwriter and the voice behind so many Take That hits. What's your favourite song penned by Gary?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! His timeless tracks always get us dancing. What's your favourite Billy Ocean hit?

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's 41st Anniversary of First Induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1986, the first ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place in New York City, honouring rock's founding pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 41 years ago today, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony, immortalising the legends who shaped music forever. Who would be your first inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, he's been a constant in British pop. What's your favourite Mark Owen moment?

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert 58th Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary impromptu rooftop concert at Apple Corps headquarters in London, their final public performance.

angles.name: Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. What a way to go out! If you could have been there, what song would you have wished for?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: Drumming Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, from Genesis to his chart-topping solo career. What's your favourite Phil Collins hit?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, a global pop superstar, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo stardom, he's consistently delivered hits. What's your favourite JT track?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles like Del Boy in 'Only Fools and Horses' and Detective Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure whose characters have brought so much joy to millions. What's your favourite David Jason role?
